episodes.synopsis: Tetsuo Tosu is a 47-year-old humble businessman who loves his family. He finds out that Reika, his daughter in college, has been physically abused by her boyfriend, Nobuto Matori, and acts to protect her, which leads to a terrible, irreparable situation.
episodes.title: From Today, I Am a Killer

episodes.synopsis: With Kasen's help, Tetsuo devises a way to dispose of the body. In the meantime, a group of men is looking for Nobuto. Tetsuo and Kasen give them false information to divert their attention.
episodes.title: Cutting the Cake

episodes.synopsis: The group of men, led by Kyoichi, finds out Tetsuo and Kasen's lie and resorts to violence to interrogate them to find out what happened to Nobuto.
episodes.title: The Correct Path

episodes.synopsis: Tetsuo and Kyoichi work together to trace Nobuto's footsteps before his disappearance. But in that process, they're given a violent and possibly fatal ultimatum by the organization.
episodes.title: The World of Violence

episodes.synopsis: Tetsuo and Kasen work with their old college friend to make it look like Nobuto is still alive. While trying to find out Nobuto's password to access his social media account, Tetsuo encounters Nobuto's father.
episodes.title: Are You Happy?

episodes.synopsis: Tetsuo succeeds in uploading the fake video of Nobuto, but it leads to more investigation by Kubo's men. Kyoichi, still suspicious of Tetsuo, decides to investigate Tetsuo's house. Without consulting Tetsuo, Kasen chooses to entertain Kyoichi...
episodes.title: Entertaining the Guest, Kasen Style

episodes.synopsis: As the deadline approaches, Tetsuo and Kasen begin putting a plan in action to frame someone else for Nobuto's murder.  Kyoichi contacts Reika and attempts to meet with her.
episodes.title: Mother and Mother

episodes.synopsis: Tetsuo races against the clock to plant evidence to frame someone else as Nobuto's murderer. Kasen scrambles to keep Reika away from Kyoichi after he tries to get in contact with her.
episodes.title: The Spider's Thread

episodes.synopsis: After Tetsuo and Kyoichi inspect Kyoichi's apartment, they share what could be their "last meal." When they go back to Takeda, new evidence shows up that makes Kyoichi a prime suspect.
episodes.title: The Fateful Day

episodes.synopsis: Tetsuo is allowed to walk away after Kyoichi is condemned by the organization. However, Kyoichi does not quietly accept his fate and attempts to escape his death sentence.
episodes.title: One Thing I Did

episodes.synopsis: Hearing the truth from Kyoichi, Matori visits Reika's apartment where Tetsuo happens to be. Just like on that fateful day, Tetsuo hides in the closet. Seeing the rage and sorrow of Matori, Tetsuo decides to ends it by confessing the crime to Matori.
episodes.title: Father

episodes.synopsis: Tetsuo and Matori remain locked in their fight to the death, both driven by their love for their families. Police come to investigate the noise created by the scuffle. The survivors are left to bury the bodies and bear the weight of their sins.
episodes.title: The Current Happiness
